description.zh: 资源归属账号ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号。
description.en: The ID of the member. If you specify this parameter, the bills of the member are queried. If you do not specify this parameter, the bills of the current account are queried by default.

description.zh: 账期YYYY－MM。仅支持最近18个月账期。
description.en:
The billing cycle. Specify the parameter in the YYYY-MM format.
Only the latest 18 month billing cycle is supported.

description.zh:
账单日期，仅当Granularity为DAILY时必填，格式为YYYY-MM-DD。

> BillingDate参数值需和BillingCycle参数月份保持一致，例如BillingCycle设置为2020-03，BillingDate需设置为2020-03-DD。若月份设置不一致，查询的结果按BillingCycle设置的时间返回。
description.en: The billing date. This parameter is required only when the Granularity parameter is set to DAILY. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

description.zh:
查询账单的颗粒度。取值如下：

- MONTHLY：月。与费用与成本-费用账单-账单明细-账期账单一致。
- DAILY：日。与费用与成本-费用账单-账单明细-按天账单一致。

> 选择DAILY需指定BillingDate。
description.en:
The granularity at which bills are queried. Valid values:

*   MONTHLY: queries bills on a monthly basis. The data that you query is the same as the data searched by instances on the Billing Details tab of the Bill Details page in the User Center console.
*   DAILY: queries bills on a daily basis. The data that you query is the same as the data searched by days on the Billing Details tab of the Bill Details page in the User Center console.

The BillingDate parameter is required if you set the Granularity parameter to DAILY.

description.zh:
是否按照计费项维度拉取数据。

- false（默认值）：与费用与成本-费用账单-账单明细-实例账单一致。
- true：与费用与成本-费用账单-账单明细-计费项账单一致。
description.en:
Specifies whether to query data by billable items. Valid values:

*   false: The data that you query is the same as the data searched by instances on the Billing Details tab of the Bill Details page in the User Center console.
*   true: The data that you query is the same as the data searched by billable items on the Billing Details tab of the Bill Details page in the User Center console.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
根据原价（PretaxGrossAmount）和应付（PretaxAmount）是否都为0做过滤。取值：
- false。
- true。
description.en:
Specifies whether to filter bills if both the pretax gross amount and pretax amount are 0. Valid values:

*   false: does not filter bills.
*   true: filters bills.

description.zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量。默认值：20，最大值：300。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300.

description.zh: 用来表示当前调用开始读取的位置，参数值必须为空或者使用返回结果中的NextToken设值，否则会报错。空代表从头开始读取。
description.en: The token that is used to indicate the position where the results for the current call start. The parameter must be left empty or set to the value of the NextToken parameter that is returned from the last call. Otherwise, an error is returned. If the parameter is left empty, data is queried from the first item.

description.zh: 产品Code，与费用中心账单产品Code一致。
description.en: The code of the service. The code is the same as that in Cost Center.

description.zh:
订阅类型。取值：
- Subscription：预付费。
- PayAsYouGo：后付费。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

*   Subscription: the subscription billing method.
*   PayAsYouGo: the pay-as-you-go billing method.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi describe-instance-bill --billing-cycle 2020-03 --product-code rds --product-type rds --subscription-type PayAsYouGo --is-billing-item false --next-token CAESEgoQCg4KCm --max-results 20 --is-hide-zero-charge false --billing-date 2020-03-02 --granularity MONTHLY --bill-owner-id 122 --instance-id abc --pip-code rds --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi DescribeInstanceBill --region cn-hangzhou --BillingCycle '2020-03' --NextToken CAESEgoQCg4KCm --ProductCode rds --IsHideZeroCharge false --InstanceID abc --MaxResults 20 --ProductType rds --BillOwnerId 122 --IsBillingItem false --BillingDate '2020-03-02' --Granularity MONTHLY --PipCode rds --SubscriptionType PayAsYouGo
